tasks.behavior: Prove merchant checkout fulfillment and reconciliation end to end
acceptance: The example merchant prices a cart on its server, creates real checkouts, verifies events and fulfills an order once across hosted and embedded flows.
Independent shared-link customers, client invoicing, multi-store isolation, expiration, partial payment, delivery recovery and spoofed prices/messages have automated workflow coverage.
Ledger/export totals reconcile against receiver and wallet chain balances; duplicate/reordered events cannot double-fulfill.
Quickstart and integration docs match implemented packages; provider limitations, actual user testing and release approvals are reported truthfully.

tasks.behavior: Fix audit findings in payment reads, permissions and forms
acceptance: Public and owner invoice reads bound deposit history while keeping exact totals and payment behavior across checkout, details and documents.
Store edits preserve unavailable token restrictions and cannot change them without permission; concurrent job creation respects the profile limit.
Title-only link edits preserve exact expiry; CSV and PDF exports wait for the chosen records currency to save.
Deposit lookup and payment ordering use measured indexes; SDK agreed fiat amounts document decimal major units.
notes: 2026-10-28 review pass by independent-reviewer: Reviewed the full diff and owning structure rules. Regression tests cover token permissions, concurrent job limits and retries, exact link expiry, currency-save recovery, bounded invoice previews with exact totals, and API/PDF output. Deposit evidence and ledger totals share a consistent snapshot; all readers remain bounded. Migration indexes have measured query improvements. Final verify passed docs-check, lint, typecheck, unit, build, e2e and protected paths. No remaining findings.

proof.1: unit: Public, owner and summary API regressions cap deposit previews, preserve exact totals and representative evidence, and verify receipt totals and disclosure; frontend regressions preserve full-history amounts.
proof.2: unit: Disabled-chain and disabled-token API regressions preserve restrictions; deterministic concurrent job creation enforces the cap and same-key replay.
proof.3: unit: Link form tests preserve exact expiry; CSV and PDF tests block export during currency saves and recover after failed or lost responses.
proof.4: unit: Migration rollback and reapply pass; disposable EXPLAIN proofs measured deposit lookups at 812-853ms before and 8.4-9.2ms after, and payment list at 8.1-9.0ms before and 0.80-1.08ms after. SDK input comment now specifies decimal major units.
